subject: Request: StrataPulse accelerator discount exception (VP/CFO signoff needed)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc:

Subject: StrataPulse — accelerator pilot proposal & discount ask

Team,

Quick one: Ari (StrataPulse) circled back after the demo and is asking for an aggressive accelerator package to lock a strategic pilot. They want a 12-month commitment with immediate deployment across 3 product lines. Commercial ask: 45% off list for the first 12 months + $75k onboarding credit. Their ARR profile is modest (projected first-year consumption ~$420k list), but they are a strategic partner in our target channel and may co-sell in Q2.

Why I’m escalating: our standard guardrail for mid-market pilots maxes at 30% + $25k onboarding credit. The proposed 45% would be a material precedent if we approve without executive sign-off. I want to surface this as an exception request for VP/CFO approval.

Attachments: StrataPulse_SOW_v1.pdf; Redwood_discount_workup.xlsx; StrataPulse_Roadmap_Deck.pdf

Ask: Please review the attached numbers and weigh in with recommended concession ceiling and any non-negotiable contractual protections (audit, usage floors, performance milestones). If you can, propose exact language we can send to Ari (i.e., what we can commit to now vs. what needs exec signoff). I’d like to have a firm position to share with procurement by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StrataPulse — accelerator pilot proposal & discount ask

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the workbook. High-level thoughts:
- 45% + $75k onboarding would push our first-year net down to ~$200k (roughly 52% gross discount + credits). That is outside our normal economics and would set a tough precedent in our vertical.
- Upside: StrataPulse does have credible co-sell potential and references in two target healthcare accounts. We should quantify how much pipeline attribution they commit to in writing.
- Risk controls: require a 6-month performance milestone with a renewal-triggered true-up and clawback language for over-provisioned credits. Also insist on a minimum committed monthly spend (e.g., $25k/mo) to avoid zero-usage pilots.

Recommended commercial compromise to present for exec consideration:
1) 35% off list year 1 (instead of 45%)
2) Onboarding credit capped at $40k (not $75k) with invoice milestones tied to onboarding deliverables
3) 6-month performance review; if usage >110% of projected by month 9, apply a negotiated graduated rebate for year 2 rather than up-front discount.

If leadership is comfortable with the strategic argument, I can draft a short exception memo for VP/CFO signoff. Karthik — can you run legal redlines we must include for audit/usage clauses?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StrataPulse — accelerator pilot proposal & discount ask

Forwarding legal/commercial checklist below. I ran a quick pass on the SOW and the items we need to protect Redwood: 
- Usage floor: define minimum monthly committed spend (recommended $20k/mo) and include a bi-directional termination option if floor not met after 90 days post-onboarding (with prorated repayment of credits).
- Audit clause: 60-day window for usage audit after quarter close; breach triggers repayment of onboarding credits prorated to under-usage.
- IP/Co-sell: limit joint-marketing commitments to named accounts and include opt-out if demo/reference requests exceed agreed cadence.
- Auto-renewal: avoid an auto-extend clause that locks year 2 rates unless both parties sign.

I attached a short redline snippet and a recommended exec memo blurb we can drop into the VP/CFO note. My ask: if we go above 35% discount or above $50k onboarding credit, require VP + CFO sign-off and a finance escalation ticket created in HubSpot with the deal id.

Karthik Iyer
Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

- Strategic rationale: StrataPulse is willing to (a) name Redwood in two co-sell plays in Q2 and (b) pilot a joint case study if metrics are met. They flagged accelerated procurement timelines if we can commit this month.

Requested action: Please confirm approval or propose edits. If you approve, would you sign the attached short exception memo (I can route via DocuSign) so we can lock the deal before their procurement window closes on Oct 25?

Thanks — appreciate quick eyes on this.
Marcus

Marcus/Marissa/Karthik —

Thank you for the clear analysis. I will sign an exception memo on the following conditional terms:
1) Approve a one-time 35% discount for year 1 (not to exceed $147k in total year-1 discount based on current forecast).
2) Onboarding credit approved up to $40k; any credits beyond $40k require CFO written approval.
3) Include a $20k/month minimum committed spend for the first 6 months, with a 90-day remediation window; if the minimum is not met and remediation fails, onboarding credits will be repaid on a prorated basis.
4) Commit to a 6-month performance review; if usage materially exceeds projections during month 7-9, commercial team may propose a year-2 rebate structure but only after Finance sign-off.
5) Legal to include an audit clause (60 days post-quarter) and limit co-sell commitments to named accounts only.

Condition precedent: please create a HubSpot finance escalation ticket referencing deal RDW-2026-0861 and attach the signed exception memo and final SOW before routing to procurement. Karthik/legal — please add the audit/clawback language to the SOW and route to external counsel if necessary.

I will sign the DocuSign if the final memo reflects the items above. Marcus — please get Ari to confirm the committed co-sell accounts and send the final SOW to procurement ASAP.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Strategy, Redwood Inference
